run_order.description: Load the Reddit research plan from the API.
Load strategy, safety budget, lane turn, and intervention status.
Verify daily/monthly and per-run-type budget before proceeding.
Verify no critical intervention triggers before proceeding.
Read portfolio, positions, index quotes (SPY/QQQ), and recent orders via Robinhood MCP.
Load quotes, indices, volatility proxy, and freshness checklist.
Fetch public Reddit finance listings via the API (do not scrape login-gated pages). Ingest mention summaries into the news store.
Read ranked ticker mentions and sample posts. Focus on allowed_symbols with the highest post_count.
Read stored news including source=reddit plus RSS/earnings context for confirmation.
Load memory for open positions and top Reddit mentions you will analyze.

Social-first but not social-only: Reddit mentions set the candidate list. Confirm with quotes/tape before simulated_buy. Manage open positions with trim/stop/take-profit/flatten. Fade one-off hype with no tape confirmation.
Call review_equity_order for any would-be live trade; never place unless safety.trading_allowed.
Verify Reddit mentions were cited, tape confirmation exists for entries, and position-management actions were considered for open lots.
POST completed or failed run with decisions, quotes, usage, and errors.

scoring_rules_extra.rule: News/social score is the primary driver. New simulated_buy requires a named Reddit thread or mention rollup in action_rationale plus news score >= 0.55.
Do not buy Reddit hype against hostile tape. simulated_buy also needs technical >= 0.45 and confidence >= 0.55. If mentions are hot but the quote is dumping, skip or wait.
Never log trades on symbols outside allowed_symbols. Mentions outside the list are research-only (skip).
Raise risk when a name is dominated by YOLO/meme language, very new listings, or a single viral post. Prefer liquid large/mid-caps and major ETFs. Size $150–$300.
If an open position's Reddit sentiment flips clearly negative or the catalyst post ages out with no follow-through, prefer simulated_trim, simulated_stop, or simulated_flatten over hold.
When Reddit ingest fails or returns no usable mentions, do not force new entries. Manage existing positions only and explain the gap.

required_inputs_extra.name: reddit_research
required_inputs_extra.description: Public finance-subreddit posts, extracted tickers, and mention rollups.

data_sources_extra.name: reddit_public_json
data_sources_extra.description: API fetches public Reddit listings (wallstreetbets, stocks, investing, StockMarket, earnings). No login scraping.

stop_conditions_extra.description: If Reddit ingest/fetch fails, skip new entries; still manage open paper positions.
Viral mentions without quote confirmation must not become simulated_buy.
